teacher_info.introduction: I am a certified English teacher looking to support students as effectively as possible within their desired time frame. Coming from an extensive academic background I have been able to observe and adopt effective teaching techniques which I plan to carry forward in my teaching career. My knowledge and experience have been enriched by a class taught TEFL course by The TEFL Academy in London. This was a tremendous experience and very demanding at the same time as the course was intensive and interactive covering core teaching values, methods, learning areas, assessment techniques, bearing in mind student engagement and cooperation at all times. My knowledge, experience, enthusiasm but primarily ambition are the key reasons for me to want to pass on all I know about one of the world’s most spoken language. teacher_info.about_teacher:
Every class is tailored to the individual needs of the student.
I want to know your goals. Based upon that we can find the best speed and intensity in your learning process. 
I specialize in conversational classes, in which you will do majority of the talking, so the topics we discuss will be chosen with you in mind. I love using books, articles, music and any other artistic bodies of work to make it engaging and interesting for the student. We can also work with traditional textbooks and materials.
Any homework will be something fun that relates to our discussion or lesson. 
F.g. to read an article, song lyrics or simply watch a movie. If needed, some engaging grammar exercises.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is practical in nature. 
If you cannot remember a word I would like for you to explain what you mean in the best way you can. That way we can focus on making your speech go in tandem with your thoughts. We will also make sure to expand your vocabulary depending on the topic at hand. When the need arises I will correct any grammatical errors you might be making and try to find the most efficient way for you to express what you mean.
All of this while having a nice conversation about a topic that interests you~

~If there are topics that you want to explore or are passionate about I am very open to finding out more about them with you~

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading
pro_course_detail.description:
This is not be a lesson, neither a translation. You'll send me a file and I will correct the text you've written in English and send it back to you within 48h.
15$ is for an academic text and 12$ for everything else. If it's longer than 1 page I'll send you a request with the changed price. 1 page means: size 12 font (Times New Roman) with 1.5 line spacing.
To improve your work I can provide you with some options and their short explanations.
I'll accept the request after checking the text. Please send your file in a pdf, word or google document. I'll send back the finished work in two of those formats, unless specifically instructed otherwise. 
If you'd like to meet and discuss the changes and suggestions for future work please let me know.

pro_course_detail.title: Polish for beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
This is an ice-breaker option. These lessons are perfect for students who have little to no previous experience with Polish. We will focus on the most useful words and expressions and we will get into the conversation zone in a fun and relaxed way. For example, I will be asking simple questions in Polish, typing them along with the translation in the chat. You don’t know how to answer? No problem, say what you want to say in your language. Based on that I will give you a few Polish versions of what you said and we will break it down so that you can understand better how it works. You will be amazed by how quickly you will learn, because it will be so much easier for you to remember the sentences, thanks to the fact that those sentences will be yours! Yes, personalization makes a huge difference. Instead of learning random sentences from Duolingo, with me you will only learn the sentences that you can literally copy and paste into your real life conversation. 
My goal is to get you to the conversational level as soon as possible.

We will:
• Personalize the learning experience
• Start speaking from the very beginning
• Find the most effective and attractive way for you to learn

Requirements:
Be on time. Be prepared. Be open to try new learning methods. Be transparent with me. Have trust. Having a good teacher is very important although it’s all up to you whether you are going to learn or not. I can only make this process quicker and more enjoyable. Please note that I do not work with kids, so I kindly ask you not to book the classes for your kids.

pro_course_detail.description:
I understand that finding a good teacher can be similar to finding a good friend. It takes time, but it really pays off. These conversational classes are here to help you become a confident speaker in a fun and relaxed way. I will teach you a lot of vocabulary through speaking together. I will challenge your speaking abilities and I will help you to build new expressions and idioms to sound more like a native speaker. I’m very encouraging and supportive so you don’t have to worry about the mistakes. It’s part of the game! If you want, you can come to me with a list of things that you want to talk about or we can just go with the flow. My goal is to get you to the point where you can handle the conversation in a natural way and you can respond to the questions quickly and spontaneously. Let’s improve your pronunciation, elevate your vocabulary and help you express ideas with more fluidity together.

We will:

pro_course_detail.title: English for beginners
pro_course_detail.description:

We will focus on the most useful words and expressions and we will get into the conversation zone in a fun and relaxed way. For example, I will be asking simple questions in English, typing them along with the translation in the chat. You don’t know how to answer? No problem, say what you want to say in your language. Based on that I will give you a few English versions of what you said and we will break it down so that you can understand better how it works. You will be amazed by how quickly you will learn, because it will be so much easier for you to remember the sentences, thanks to the fact that those sentences will be yours! Yes, personalization makes a huge difference. Instead of learning the random sentences from Duolingo, with me you will only learn the sentences that you can literally copy and paste into your real life conversation.

teacher_info.introduction:
Cześć, Hola, Hello

I'm a copywriter with passion for writing & an experienced online teacher. I graduated from University of Lodz with a bachelor's degree in Journalism & Media Communication.
TESL- & TEYL-certified teacher + Título de Bachiller - Bilingual High School Diploma ES-PL.
I love travelling, reading, writing, talking with people & everything language-related-to. I also had a pleasure to travel all over the world visiting many different countries from six continents & making friends everywhere.
Therefore, learning foreign languages is my passion but I find teaching languages even more interesting & satisfying as I love helping people & changing their lives.

Do you need English, Spanish or Polish as per job duties?
Business trip coming & you need to boost your confidence?
Do you feel your career could go better?
Are you interested in cultural things?
Would you love to learn foreign languages just for fun & to train your brain?
Fun & learning for kids?
Say yes!
I know why you are here.
& whatever is your reason - I'm here to help you & to change your life or cultural experience.

You can say: I've been to Cuba, I visited South America but without Spanish your trip wasn't so culturally rich as it could be with Spanish knowledge.
You can say: I love Miłosz's poems but you read them losing half of their beauty due to translation, or Kieślowski's movies with subtitles... Though in both cases translators did their best job, you should feel you missed something important - language experience.
Language is build by history, traditions, beliefs.
I'm here - to pass it to You in the most convenient way you wish to choose :
*Spontaneous & interesting conversations
*Analysis of lyrics, poetry etc.
*Following the book of your choice
*Custom-tailored courses
* Bilingual or trilingual classes
* Happy classes for kids

You'll thank me later, after 10, 20, maybe even 30 years later when you look back at your life from the different perspective

Dziękuje, Gracias, Thank you
